key_insight: SWE-Serve benchmarks whether agents can make production-correct inference-serving changes across the full stack, not just complete local coding tasks.
engineering_relevance: It gives practitioners a realistic testbed for repository-scale serving work, including API, runtime, performance, and end-to-end correctness checks.
method: 53 repository-grounded tasks derived from real SGLang production changes
Covers six inference engineering families on CPU or a single H100 GPU
Uses hidden functional/regression tests plus E2E serving tests and calibrated performance gates
evidence_signal: Across 11 models and 31 effort settings, the best configuration reached 75% mean pass@1, and E2E tests rejected about one-third of patches that otherwise passed.
watch_item: Because tasks are derived from one serving stack and one benchmark setup, results may not fully generalize to other inference systems or deployment environments.
paper_title: SWE-Serve: Benchmarking Agentic Engineering For Production Inference Serving
